STS2_NAVIA_KEYWORD_LOAD.title: Load
STS2_NAVIA_KEYWORD_LOAD.description: Up to 6 stacks (each Rifled Barrel raises the cap by 3, stacking). Every 2 stacks grant +1 Block when you gain Block and +1 attack damage (the same bonuses Dexterity and Strength give, but they cannot be stolen or removed). Many cards expend Load for extra effects.
STS2_NAVIA_KEYWORD_SALVO.title: Salvo
STS2_NAVIA_KEYWORD_SALVO.description: Raises the damage of the Golden Rose Cannons currently in your deck by that value (instant; newly generated cannons start at base damage). If you have no Golden Rose Cannon in hand when triggered, add 1 to your hand.
STS2_NAVIA_KEYWORD_SUPPORT.title: Support
STS2_NAVIA_KEYWORD_SUPPORT.description: An enhancement placed on another card that lasts until the end of this combat. A card can hold only one Support effect at a time; its effect is shown on the card.
